content: Hammer (hex package, ETS-backed by default, no Redis needed at this scale) + Hammer.Plug is the standard Elixir rate-limiting choice, added as a plug keyed by IP or session with a rate/scale/limit tuple (e.g. N requests per M ms). ETS backend is process-local/single-node which fits this project's single-host Kamal deploy (no distributed cache needed). Typical use: protect login/magic-link-request endpoints and any public form-submission endpoint from abuse; NOT typically applied to normal read-only catalog browsing.
